MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 对 duì mean in a true-or-false exercise? (1 mark)
   A. Family
   B. Right
   C. Father
   D. Wrong

2. What does 我爱你 wǒ ài nǐ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am you
   B. I see you
   C. I love you
   D. I like you

3. What is intonation? (1 mark)
   A. The size of a character
   B. The spelling of a word
   C. The number of strokes
   D. How the voice rises and falls

4. What does the small mark 、 do in a list? (1 mark)
   A. It separates items in the list
   B. It asks a question
   C. It ends a sentence
   D. It shows a tone

5. What is vocal projection? (1 mark)
   A. Reading in a whisper
   B. Sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting
   C. Reading without tones
   D. Reading very fast

6. What does 星期五,去清真寺 mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Monday, go to school
   B. On Friday, rest at home
   C. On Sunday, go to church
   D. On Friday, go to the mosque

7. In reading aloud, what is stress? (1 mark)
   A. Saying an important word a little stronger
   B. Reading without tones
   C. Stopping after every word
   D. Reading in a whisper

8. What does 月 (yuè) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To play
   B. To give (a gift)
   C. Candle
   D. Month

9. What does 牛奶 niúnǎi mean? (1 mark)
   A. Chicken
   B. Milk
   C. Beef
   D. Tea

10. Which word is pronounced shénme? (1 mark)
   A. 什么
   B. 蔬菜
   C. 牛奶
   D. 零食

11. What is skimming? (1 mark)
   A. Copying a text
   B. Writing a text
   C. Looking for one word
   D. Reading quickly to get the general idea

12. What does 头 (tóu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eye
   B. Head
   C. Tooth
   D. Ear

13. Why do we pause when we read aloud? (1 mark)
   A. To forget words
   B. To breathe and show where ideas begin and end
   C. To change tones
   D. To read faster

14. Read the pinyin: fēng hěn dà. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sun is very big.
   B. Today it rains.
   C. The wind is very strong.
   D. Today there are clouds.

15. What is the main idea of a text? (1 mark)
   A. The first letter
   B. The title font
   C. What the whole text is about
   D. The last word

16. Which sentence means "The bathroom is beside the garden."? (1 mark)
   A. 电视在哪儿?
   B. 门在左边。
   C. 浴室在花园旁边。
   D. 窗户在沙发上面。

17. Which stroke goes from left to right? (1 mark)
   A. 横 héng
   B. 竖 shù
   C. 撇 piě
   D. 点 diǎn

18. Read the pinyin: wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello! (polite)
   B. Good morning!
   C. My name is Xiaoming.
   D. Hello!

19. How is a sentence about a person written? (1 mark)
   A. 家有 + 。
   B. 是这我 + 。
   C. 这是我 + family word + 。
   D. 我这是 + 。

20. What does 有 (yǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To have, there is
   B. Father
   C. Older sister
   D. Is, am, are

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write a five-sentence description of your family in Chinese with pinyin, using 这是 and 我家有. (5 marks)

22. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: míngtiān shì xīngqīsì. (2 marks)

23. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ ài nǐ. (2 marks)

24. What is the job of 吗 in a sentence? Give an example. (2 marks)

25. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a television in the living room." (3 marks)

26. Read and translate: 星期一到星期五,去学校。 (3 marks)

27. Write two sentences about your family with 这是, and give pinyin. (3 marks)

28. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is on the table." (3 marks)

29. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nǐ ne? (2 marks)

30. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "There is a bed in the bedroom." (2 marks)

31. Write the pinyin for 爸爸, 妈妈 and 姐姐. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Right
   对 means right; 错 means wrong.

2. C — I love you
   爱 is love.

3. D — How the voice rises and falls
   Intonation is the rise and fall of the voice.

4. A — It separates items in the list
   、 is the list comma.

5. B — Sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting
   Good breathing and an open mouth help you project.

6. D — On Friday, go to the mosque
   清真寺 is a mosque.

7. A — Saying an important word a little stronger
   Stress makes key words stand out but does not change the tone.

8. D — Month
   月 (yuè) means month.

9. B — Milk
   牛奶 is milk; 牛肉 is beef.

10. A — 什么
   什么 is pronounced shénme and means what.

11. D — Reading quickly to get the general idea
   Skimming gives you the main idea.

12. B — Head
   头 (tóu) means head.

13. B — To breathe and show where ideas begin and end
   Pauses help the reader and the listener.

14. C — The wind is very strong.
   fēng hěn dà. is 风很大。, which means "The wind is very strong.".

15. C — What the whole text is about
   Details support the main idea.

16. C — 浴室在花园旁边。
   浴室在花园旁边。 (yùshì zài huāyuán pángbiān.) means "The bathroom is beside the garden.".

17. A — 横 héng
   横 is the horizontal stroke.

18. C — My name is Xiaoming.
   wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng. is 我叫小明。, which means "My name is Xiaoming.".

19. C — 这是我 + family word + 。
   For example 这是我爸爸。

20. A — To have, there is
   有 (yǒu) means to have, there is.

SECTION B
----
21. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我家有五口人。这是我爸爸。这是我妈妈。这是我哥哥。这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba. zhè shì wǒ māma. zhè shì wǒ gēge. zhè shì wǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence, with pinyin and correct tones.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tomorrow is Thursday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: I love you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: 吗 makes a yes-or-no question, for example 电视在桌子上吗?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the job and 1 mark for the example.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: 客厅里有电视。 kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, qù xuéxiào. From Monday to Friday, go to school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for pinyin and 2 marks for the meaning.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba. 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence, 1 mark for correct pinyin.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: 电视在桌子上。 diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: And you?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: 卧室里有床。 wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: bàba, māma, jiějie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each with the correct tone marks.
